symptom: ako/mxcli#2043: a `create or modify` of one large microflow ran past the 5-minute statement limit (and, before #2049, crashed exec); every `call microflow` target is resolved through Reader.GetRawUnitByName.
cause: GetRawUnitByName read and decoded every unit of the type on each call (the PERF NOTE from #651), so a flow build cost distinct callees x microflows unit reads; the executor's per-build memo only removes repeats of the same name.
file: modelsdk/mpr/reader_raw.go (nameIndex hint + unitNamed verification), modelsdk/mpr/reader_units.go (InvalidateCache clears it)
insight: A name index on a reader that other processes may rewrite is safe as a hint, not an answer: re-read the one unit it names and check name, $Type and module, and fall back to the scan on any mismatch or miss. Count unit reads (fileReads + UnitStoreHits) to test it, net of buildModuleResolution's per-call reads, which are not the type's units.
